lidl.title: Lidl Plus — log in
lidl.description:
1. On a computer, open developer tools (F12) in the browser, **Network** tab, and enable *Preserve log*.
2. Open [the Lidl login page]({url}) in the same tab and log in to your Lidl Plus account.
3. At the end the browser will try to open an address starting with `com.lidlplus.app://callback?code=…` — find it in the Network tab (the `Location` header of the last redirect, or a failed request) and paste it below.

The code is single-use and valid for a few minutes.

error.cannot_connect: Could not connect to the chain's service.
error.invalid_auth_code: Invalid or expired code — log in again using the link (it has been regenerated).

abort.wrong_account: You logged in to a different account than the one configured.

add_from_image.name: Add receipt from photo
add_from_image.description: Reads a paper receipt from a photo using AI Task and saves it to the database. The chain is recognised from the seller name; duplicates of already imported receipts (same total within 10 minutes) are skipped. Add the “Paper receipts” entry to get sensors and recurring products for them.
